At 16¢ the Thor P2 costs about $19 a month to run, and it's $369. You get a real draw at a full block every ten minutes, forever, plus steady sats to your own wallet.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?

context.pop: At 10¢ the Hammer Miner Thor P2 runs about $12 a month, at 16¢ about $19 — what do you pay for power?
